scope_note: Second-pass direct-evidence audit for Google Clarksville in Montgomery County, Tennessee. The review covered Tennessee Comptroller industrial-development-board PILOT filings for 2019-2025; the Montgomery County assessor GIS parcel service and Trustee tax-bill portal; parcel-linked stormwater files; Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission materials; IDB, county-commission and city agenda archives; state and federal environmental portals; operator location, environmental, economic-impact and watershed materials; utility annual reports; and public workforce, contractor, procurement and recipient sources. Fifty-eight incremental quantitative observations are preserved: thirteen annual Foxman LLC estimated-actual-property-value stocks, eighteen account-level appraised-value stocks, eighteen account-level zero tax levies, a realized opening-period employee snapshot, a construction-workforce projection, and seven recipient-specific community contributions. The direct Trustee records resolve the ordinary tax bills as 0%-taxable, zero-assessed-taxable-value, zero-levy bills; they do not resolve the separate contractual PILOT payments left blank in state filings, and the portal's generic paid/zero-balance label is not treated as a cash receipt. The selected inventory key is one building, while parcel, account and environmental evidence is campus or company/county scoped and remains unallocated. Statewide investment and modeled impact totals, shared Alabama-Tennessee renewable capacity, regional watershed contributions, vendor presence without paid-contract evidence, and proposals for later Building 13 work are excluded from canonical project records. A single optional synthesis reproduces the operator's 2024 Montgomery County water-consumption identity at unallocated location scope; no multiplier, supplier-retention, fiscal-net, public-cost, energy, payroll or causal county model is created.

sources.title: Montgomery County GIS Parcels Map Service, parcel layer 0
sources.notes: Exact query: PropertyAddress LIKE '%BOOLEAN%' OR PropertyAddress LIKE '%SOLAR%', returning AccountNumber, GISLINK, GISLINK2, ParcelNo, Owner1, Owner2, PropertyAddress, CALC_ACRE, DeedAcreage, MktLandValue, BuildingValue, MiscImprovementValue, MktAppraisedValue, AssessedValue, RecordYear, TaxingDistrict, LandUseDesc, PropertyTypeDesc and WebUrl, with geometry disabled. A separate Owner1 LIKE '%FOXMAN%' query returned no features, consistent with current assessor ownership under the IDB rather than disproving the Foxman leasehold.

project_updates.notes: Google's 2015 ownership statement; Montgomery County stormwater permits 13099, 13652, 14780 and 17507; the current operator milestone page; assessor account 6490; and 2026 county/RPC Foxman records were cross-checked. They link Google/Foxman to map 009 parcel 014.01, document phased site work in 2017-2019 and official opening in 2019, and distinguish later Building 13 proposals from the selected inventory building.
project_updates.project_description: Google Clarksville is Google LLC's operating data-center campus at 1000 Boolean Drive (formerly 1000 Solar Way) in Clarksville, Montgomery County, Tennessee, on the former Hemlock Semiconductor site. Google announced its acquisition of the roughly 1,300-acre site in December 2015; county stormwater records show Foxman LLC phases SPC 1A-1C receiving grading approvals in 2017-2018, and Google reports that the data center officially opened in 2019. Current county assessor data identify IDB-owned account 6490, parcel 009 01401 000, at 1000 Boolean Drive with 1,331.21 deed acres. The project key maps one inventory building, while tax, PILOT and permit records describe the broader campus, including a separate 2026 Building 13 site review, so campus and account values are not allocated to the selected building.

project_updates.title: PILOT and property-value record audit, 2019-2025
project_updates.notes: Tennessee Comptroller annual IDB filings were searched by Foxman LLC, parcel 009 01401 000 and personal-property variants for 2019-2025. Thirteen estimated-actual-value stocks are retained; the 2022 report contains only the real-property row. The county Trustee lookup was then run for map 9/parcel 14.01 and each 2020-2025 tax year. It resolves ordinary real and personal-property bills at 0% taxable and $0 levy, but not the contract payment columns left blank in the state PILOT filings; therefore no PILOT paid, PILOT receipt, abatement realization or fiscal-net claim is created.

project_updates.title: Permit, planning and expansion audit
project_updates.notes: County stormwater current-project files and RPC agenda SR-14-2026 were searched using Foxman, Google, 1000 Solar Way, 1000 Boolean Drive and parcel 009-014.01. These sources establish project phases and a later 15,200-square-foot Building 13 proposal but publish no permit valuation, completed construction cost, procurement ledger, employment realization or operating utility increment.

project_updates.title: Investment and operator-impact audit
project_updates.notes: Google's current Tennessee page and Deloitte-prepared 2024 impact report were checked for Clarksville-specific realized capital, operations and fiscal amounts. More than $6 billion is explicitly statewide, while the report's more-than-$2.1-billion infrastructure input and $263-million GDP, 2,235-job and $169-million labor-income results are Tennessee-level contribution estimates; none is transcribed or re-modeled as a project or county observation.

project_updates.title: Operating workforce and payroll audit
project_updates.notes: Operator milestone/location pages, the January 2020 MTIDA newsletter, Google careers results and local employer coverage were searched for Google/Foxman Clarksville establishment headcount, FTEs, occupations, wages, payroll, residence and contractor inclusion. Only the January 2020 approximate 70-employee operating snapshot is retained. A later report gives a 30% veteran-workforce share but no compatible count or denominator detail; no annual headcount series, payroll, wage, local-resident share or current establishment census was found.

project_updates.title: Construction labor and supplier/procurement audit
project_updates.notes: Groundbreaking coverage and federal EEOC records identify a projection of at least 1,000 construction workers and Whiting-Turner's general-contractor role from at least May 2018 through fall 2019. The 2025 Trustee parcel search also lists address-level personal-property accounts for 1 Design, Faith Technologies, First Fleet, Guckenheimer, Henkels & McCoy, Midwest Steel and Schenker. Those listings show account presence, not project invoices, paid contract values, job-years, payroll, worker residence, subcontractor payments, vendor locality or local-purchase share, so no supplier or multiplier record is added.

project_updates.title: Water, wastewater and environmental audit
project_updates.notes: Google's 2025 Environmental Report location schedule and methodology were checked against Clarksville Gas & Water/public-works pages, county stormwater records, Tennessee environmental portals and EPA ECHO using Google, Foxman, 1000 Boolean, 1000 Solar, Montgomery and FRS 110071078889. The operator gives 2024 Montgomery County withdrawal, discharge and consumption, but no selected-building split; discharge may be engineering-estimated. No municipal bill, meter, wastewater fee, reclaimed-water quantity, peak-day use, permit discharge series or attributed infrastructure cost was found. The optional synthesis retains only the published identity and rounding at unallocated company/county scope.

project_updates.title: Electricity, renewable-energy and capacity audit
project_updates.notes: CDE Lightband FY2018-2019 through FY2020-2021 annual-report PDFs were searched for Google, Foxman, Solar, Boolean, substation, kWh and MW; operator location/impact material and TVA results were searched for Clarksville allocation, rates, demand charges and generators. CDE publishes system or unrelated-substation quantities but no project load, bill, rate class or infrastructure attribution. The only operator renewable figure found was 308 MW shared across Alabama and Tennessee, with no Clarksville allocation; no project energy observation or model is created.

project_updates.title: Community and recipient-record audit
project_updates.notes: Google/Deloitte, Austin Peay, Montgomery County, CDE Lightband, Clarksville EDC-sponsored coverage and watershed sources were reconciled by recipient and period. Seven bounded recipient amounts are retained, including separate $25,000 utility-relief and $12,500 veterans-coalition contributions. They may be components of broader operator totals and are not summed to them. The $943,000 surrounding-community total, more-than-$1.5-million watershed total, statewide philanthropy and multi-county program grants remain excluded because geography or overlap cannot be reconciled.

project_updates.title: Fiscal receipts, incentives and public-cost audit
project_updates.notes: The Trustee lookup was executed for map 9/parcel 14.01 in every tax year 2020-2025 and bill details were opened for IDB real account 3422, Foxman/IDB personal account 110059 and Google personal account 110128. Eighteen appraised-value stocks and eighteen exact zero ordinary-tax levies are retained account by account. They establish exempt ordinary billing, not the separate PILOT formula or payment, a cash receipt, payment allocation, avoided-tax counterfactual, infrastructure expenditure, marginal service cost or net benefit.

project_updates.title: County-outcome and causal-evidence audit
project_updates.notes: Federal BEA, BLS and Census county/industry series and the Deloitte statewide impact study were considered only after the direct project searches. Public county series do not isolate Google from Fort Campbell, population growth, other investment, the 2020 shock or later campus phases, and no documented comparison group or defensible treatment timing was found. No descriptive comparison gap, multiplier transfer or claimed county effect is added.

project_updates.title: Assessor parcel and ownership query trail
project_updates.notes: The county ArcGIS parcel layer was queried exactly for PropertyAddress LIKE '%BOOLEAN%' OR PropertyAddress LIKE '%SOLAR%' with parcel, owner, acreage and value fields and no geometry. Main result account 6490 is parcel 009 01401 000, IDB-owned, 1000 Boolean Drive, 1,331.21 deed acres and exempt. Owner1 LIKE '%FOXMAN%' returned no features because current assessor ownership is under the IDB. The layer's RecordYear 2027 amounts are forward of this 2026 review and are excluded; nearby 998 Boolean Drive parcel 009 01406 00002009 is not merged without boundary evidence.

project_updates.title: IDB agreement, compliance and distribution audit
project_updates.notes: The public IDB meetings/agendas pages and indexed clientuploads were searched for Google, Foxman, PILOT and parcel 009-014.01. The visible archive begins in 2022; the May 11, 2022 IDB agenda concerns unrelated projects. No 2015-2021 Google/Foxman lease, payment formula, annual compliance report, distribution schedule, minutes or clawback term was surfaced. These remain public-records-request gaps.

project_updates.title: County legislative-record audit
project_updates.notes: Montgomery County commission agenda/resolution and clerk minutes archives were searched across 2015-2026 for Google, Foxman, PILOT, 1000 Solar, 1000 Boolean and parcel 009-014.01. No project-specific agreement, county receipt allocation, payment schedule, infrastructure appropriation, compliance action or clawback was surfaced. This negative search is not evidence that no responsive record exists.

project_updates.title: City legislative-record audit
project_updates.notes: The City of Clarksville Agenda Center and linked prior-year document archive were searched across 2015-2026 using Google, Foxman, PILOT, 1000 Solar, 1000 Boolean and parcel 009-014.01. No project-specific agreement, city receipt allocation, payment schedule, infrastructure appropriation, compliance action or clawback was surfaced. The search result is logged as a gap, not as proof that no responsive record exists.

project_updates.title: State air-permit portal audit
project_updates.notes: TDEC's data-center guidance, Air Pollution Control permit pages and data-viewer entry points were searched for Google, Foxman, 1000 Boolean, 1000 Solar and Montgomery. The searches surfaced no project-specific numeric air permit, emissions inventory, generator capacity, fee, compliance penalty or attributable public cost. TDEC's general description of data-center permit review is not converted into a project permit or an absence-of-regulation conclusion.

project_updates.title: Federal environmental-registry audit
project_updates.notes: EPA ECHO was queried directly with FRS 110071078889. The report identifies Foxman LLC doing business as Foxman Clarksville Data Center at 1000 Boolean Drive under NAICS 518210, but no project-specific quantitative air permit, emissions inventory, generator capacity, fee, penalty, water withdrawal or selected-building allocation suitable for a canonical economic record was found.
